assumptions: No custom chord list attached; used src/pulpit/library.ts (Follow Me content) + shout I-IV-V-bVII
Tokens and defaults copied from src/pulpit/library.ts PROGRESSIONS and SHOUT_SETS (generic gospel harmony, not song transcriptions).
Voicings from src/pulpit/theory.ts chordIn + voice(low=48) + bassNote(low=28).
Band-hits '!' and tune-up '~' are performance flags (hit/run), not chord qualities.
Minor progressions are charted in the 12 parallel minor keys (Cm, Dbm, … Bm) using KEY_NAMES spelling.

naming.subtitle: Preacher Assist
naming.legacyNote: The code module is still src/pulpit/ and the current UI title is PULPIT (see MANUAL.md and src/pulpit/ui.ts) until Sanctum Build renames the chrome to Follow Me with subtitle Preacher Assist. Internal library feel id `whoop` may remain; user-facing feel label is Preaching hold. Do not brand the feature Sanctum Pulpit in new UI copy.
naming.discouragedAlias: “Hook Trigger” is not an official name. Prefer Easy Play (tap-next-chord) plus Shout/Worship levels.

playerNotes.exclusive: Setting shoutLevel > 0 clears worshipLevel, and vice versa.
playerNotes.renderScale: Math.max(shoutLevel, worshipLevel) / 4 feeds drumBar; chord samples use Math.max(shoutLevel, worshipLevel, 1) / 4.
playerNotes.olderFiveLevelMap: chord-maps/shout-iv-v-bvii.json intensityMap used a design overlay of 1–5. Follow Me should ship Shout 1–4 and Worship 1–4 to match the player. Do not add a fifth detent unless Lawrence asks.

intensityWiring.howMapsFeedEngine: Easy Play advances progression.steps; setKey() re-resolves tokens via chordIn; shoutLevel/worshipLevel scale renderChord/drumBar intensity (level/4); Follow Voice may nudge shout/worship. Chord-map JSON supplies tokens + resolved MIDI for all 12 keys so Follow Me (module src/pulpit/PulpitPlayer) / the sequencer can skip live theory if desired. Look up progressions[id].charts[keyName] (minor progressions use parallel-minor names: Fm, Cm, …). Hook chords are hookChords.byKey[keyName].

relativePairs.spellingNote: KEY_NAMES gospel-flat spelling is Dbm; conventional sharp-side name is C#m.
KEY_NAMES gospel-flat spelling is Ebm; conventional sharp-side name is D#m.
KEY_NAMES gospel-flat spelling is Abm; conventional sharp-side name is G#m.

hookChords.description: Single-tap chord vocabulary for Easy Play / the pads sequence under Follow Me (Preacher Assist). Roles are functional; tokens resolve with the same theory.ts rules (voice low=48, bassNote low=28).

bassWalks.description: Degree numbers are of the current MAJOR key. Reused from shout-iv-v-bvii.json (chrom-to-5, chrom-to-4, octave-pops, ghost-shout) with MIDI examples in all 12 keys. bass floor 28, same algorithm as theory.ts bassNote(ch, 28).

walks.description: Chromatic walkup that lands on scale degree 5 (the V root). In Ab: C Db D Eb.
Chromatic walkup that lands on scale degree 4 (the IV root). In Ab: Bb B C Db.
Shout bass octave pops: root on the beat, octave above on the off-beat.
Dense shout bass: sounded roots on the 8ths, low-velocity ghost neighbors on the 16ths.

organRunCues.description: Descending Mixolydian run from the tonic (8 eighths). Use at Shout 3–4.
Blues-scale fill (generic vocabulary, not a quoted lick). Peak shout only.
Short chromatic gliss into the next downbeat. Shout 3–4.
Organ-talk call-and-response stabs (I answers IV). Available from Shout 2 up.
